findings.text: Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q11/Q6, the rest of round eight's F-2). The isDirectory doc, CLAUDE.md and ADR 0024:94 all say these helpers never decide whether a repository is there. headOf (repo.ts:853) still decides with isDirectory(.git) and headOfGitDir, which reads an unreadable HEAD as 'no commit'. openRepo (829-830) and resolve.ts:268 act on that answer. Only a manual chmod of HEAD reaches it, and rebuildAll's removal loop keeps the rows. Fix it either way: narrow the sentence to 'a repository's folder', or state that a commit's presence is read fail-open.

Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q3). taxonomyFor now returns null for a link or a file at the root's name, and readTaxonomy reports that as 'no workspace knowledge repository yet'. The only product caller (taxonomy.ts:66-68) runs ensureRepo first, and ensureRepo refuses the link by name, so only the tests reach this message. The architecture gate's F-2 makes the same point.

Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried). A leftover lock reads as a git fault, and the intent record has no size cap. Both affect availability only.

Upheld as advisory, as filed (data-migration). The new refusal covers only a data directory with no knowledge/ folder. A second directory with its own knowledge/ still forgets the first one's rows. ADR 0024 Known limits states this, the files are never touched, and the index is rebuildable, so it is a stated limit and not a destructive step without a reason.

Upheld as advisory, as filed. The reviewer cited line 589; the judge moved it to the refusal, which is at 597-604. The refusal protects only rebuild. probes/write-under-another-data-directory.md confirms the rest: a write under a second data directory with no knowledge/ makes knowledge/ there, gives the project a '-2' folder and repoints its row. After that, rebuild is no longer refused, and under the first directory the path-only project's folder becomes an orphan. The first directory's files are untouched, and no hook, tool or view reads the index yet. The architecture and data gates file the same path.

Upheld as advisory, as filed. The reviewer cited line 106, which is upsertProposal; the judge moved it to the refusal's message at 602. The message does not name WIZARDINGCODE_MEM_STORE_DIR, and it does not say that its 'make it again, empty' way out forgets every row in the scope, which cannot be undone for a path-only project. A person can still get out from the first way out it names.

Upheld as advisory, as filed. The reviewer cited line 103; the judge moved it to the refusal's kindAt at 597-604. The refusal looks only at knowledge/ itself. With knowledge/projects/ removed whole, rebuild still forgets every project row. The data gate notes the same case.

Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried, now a stated known limit). A project folder with no repository keeps its old rows. rebuild prints 'not a repository' and exits 0, and doctor warns. The requirement that a future reader not treat those rows as current should go into the spec of the first item that reads the index.
Upheld as advisory, as filed (carried, stated). A stray non-dot file under knowledge/projects/ is a lasting orphan line and a doctor warning. It blocks nothing.

Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q5/Q6). The lead-in at :88 ('where the store decides whether a repository is there') and the 'rows stay' paragraph cover the fourth case for every path. The code keeps it only in rebuildAll (index-store.ts:597-604). probes/write-under-another-data-directory.md confirms that a write under a data directory with no knowledge/ makes the folder, gives the project '<name>-2' and repoints its row. The known limit at :183 names this only for a directory with its own knowledge/. The setup is unsupported and the files are untouched, so the judge does not raise the filed severity. Fix either way: scope :88/:92 to rebuild and extend the limit at :183, or give resolveRepo's create path the same guard. The data and risk gates file the same path.

Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q3/Q6). readTaxonomy reports a link at the root as 'no repository yet', against ADR 0024:90. The only current caller opens the root first, which refuses the link by name. Have it refuse when kindAt is 'other', or document that it must be called after the root is opened.

Upheld as advisory, as filed (Q1). probes/write-under-another-data-directory.md runs what the reviewer reasoned. A write under a data directory with no knowledge/, against rows, is accepted. It makes knowledge/, gives the project '<hash>-2', and saveRow repoints the row and drops its entry rows (2 entries become 1). rebuild there is then no longer refused, and under the first directory the path-only project's folder is an orphan. Files are never touched, and only the shell command reaches the store, so the judge does not raise the filed severity. Before any create, apply rebuildAll's test (root absent while rows exist), or state the write case in the known limit. Round eight's F-1 (rebuild forgetting every row) is closed for rebuild.
